name: one-arm-seated-palms-in-dumbbell-press.html
instructions:
1. Set the back of an adjustable bench to 90 degrees. You can also use a flat bench without back support.
2. Grab a dumbbell with a neutral grip and sit down on the bench with your feet firmly planted on the floor for stability. This is the starting position for the exercise.
3. Slowly press the dumbbell overhead by extending the elbow and contracting the deltoids.
4. Once your arm is fully extended, begin lowering the dumbbell back down to the starting position. This is one rep.
5. Repeat for desired reps, and then repeat the movement on your other arm.
